risk_note: RV2 (identity plus app.module.ts). POST /v1/auth/login/wechat and /apple leave planned by a mechanical commit (Couli-Mechanical: contract-codegen; loginByHuawei stays planned, ruling D21). Attempt checked before consumption (20004; store down 50001); exchange through ThirdPartyIdentityPort (bad credential 20004; provider unavailable or no union_id 50305 with the provider only in the log); credentials and exchange results never stored or logged except the Apple refresh_token, encrypted into user_oauth.apple_refresh_token_cipher (migration 0034) with the revoked mark cleared; restricted login without a bound account 10405 no_account (nothing written); status deleting 10007 processing; concurrent first logins re-read after the user_oauth unique violation; login_logs.method = provider and sessions.login_method (sms login now writes 'sms', D19); two consents and push binding as in sms login; device blocklist / register limit on a third-party first login → 44001 without a phone-bound risk record (ruling D24); fake adapter only in local / test, otherwise 50305. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21). Mechanical fix by the orchestrator in a separate rule-test commit after the CI run of the first landing (precedents F1-02c #22, B3-03d/e): the fixture's restricted-login channel was 'restricted', outside the contract's install_channel enum, so the oauth-attempt request itself got 400 before the login under test; it is now 'official' (the seeded app_versions row follows the constant), and the credential-scan serializer turns bigint columns into text. No assertion, vector or title changed; red re-run on the new spec commit.
